title: Material Blend 3-Mix Duo #24 (대각 띠·물결 / 동심원·물결 | 이레즈미+크리스탈+흑요암금 / 크리스탈+드래곤비늘+나비날개비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, loose beach waves mid-length tousled — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 30% of the way down her figure from the top and about 64% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, koi sakura formations in CRIMSON and PINK, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries clear quartz crystal clusters growing directly out of her own skin, erupting in true three-dimensional relief, each facet casting its own hard shadow, BLAZING CLEAR WHITE crystal points, VIVID PRISMATIC RAINBOW mineral veins. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it., no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries citrine crystal clusters growing directly out of her own skin, erupting in true three-dimensional relief, each facet casting its own hard shadow, BLAZING CITRINE YELLOW crystal points, VIVID AMBER mineral veins. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID AMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it., no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed.
#2: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
